name: grano-sign
description: Cryptographic document signing, traceability and Merkle proofs

scripts.build: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.test:all: cross-env RUN_LARGE_PAYLOAD_TESTS=1 NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 pnpm exec vitest run && pnpm run test:workers && pnpm run test:examples
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build && pnpm run test:coverage && pnpm run test:workers && pnpm run test:examples
scripts.test:examples: pnpm run build:examples && node .examples/01-basic.js && node .examples/02-workers.js && node .examples/03-anchoring-adapter.js
